policy.continuation_iterations: original local solver budget, at most one best improved start per parent
policy.bounds: original seed bounds including frozen axes
policy.admission: descending base score with stable seed-index ties, admit whole parent only
policy.selection: exact CPU NCC, keep baseline unless improved

acceptance.easy_case_overhead_limit: per-case warm median increase <= max(10% of matching baseline, 0.5 ms); measured with no retries
acceptance.full_pipeline_overhead_limit: warm median increase <= max(10% of matching baseline, 2 ms)
acceptance.active_rescue_cost: report separately; no absolute time guarantee from work proxy
acceptance.ambiguous_periodic: diagnostic, report geometric failure even with high NCC; not a claim of global optimality
acceptance.large_scope: 4K/8K supplied-seed refinement separate from global full-image detection
